one_line: The program's fossil record: four successive identities (ejection-circuits, MPA-invariants, agora-substrate, ops-pipelines) all dead by June, but holding the repo's cleanest kill discipline and three genuinely unconsumed assets — a green-tested Lean/Mathlib proof gate, the tensor_decomp_qd falsification-ladder template, and the kairos typed-failure pattern library.
open_questions: Where is Aethon's actual code? README claims 23 modules/~7,700 lines/256 tests and 7 archives, but aethon/ contains three markdown files; if the standalone repo is recoverable, its MAP-Elites-over-reasoning-configs harness is the closest existing thing to the v3 candidate-organism harness.

Do the Rhea 92%-SR checkpoints in rhea/runs/ still evaluate? The coherence-collapse caveat was never resolved (perplexity-penalty evolution 'under development' as of 2026-03-25 and never shipped) — a cheap re-run would settle whether the ejection result is a real capability or pure fitness gaming.
Was the ejection-suppression result ever replicated outside the 2026-03-24/25 sessions? No re-validation exists anywhere in the repo, yet it remains the program's most-cited 'reasoning' result.
Who is supposed to consume the Lean proof harness? 36 green tests on 2026-05-29, zero importers since; both Rhea's loop and any future Arena-style external-truth fitness need exactly this.
Is the noesis data spine reachable post-repoint? mnemosyne/STATE.md and koios/scripts still point at .176; the .202 repoint (983fd077) only touched scripts/ and apollo/.

Should agora's symbol-lifecycle semantics (immutable @vN versioning, challenge-qualified queue) be ported to the Postgres bus, or is that coordination model deliberately retired with Redis?
Why does the reassessment mislabel kairos/ as an 'ejection-failure pattern library'? If revival of the Rhea+Ignis+Kairos cluster proceeds on that description, it will revive the wrong artifact.
purpose_and_thesis: Not one subsystem but the sediment of four program eras, each with its own thesis: (1) Mar 2026 reasoning-circuits era — aethon ('evolve reasoning architectures under novelty pressure and catch emergent surprises'), arcanum ('the inference waste-stream contains stable non-human concepts worth cataloging'), ignis/rhea ('LMs compute correct answers then suppress them via a locatable ejection circuit; break it and honesty/metacognition emerge'), organisms/noesis ('a daemon composing cross-domain concept chains will find cracks — numerical structure violations — faster with tensor guidance'); (2) Apr 2026 MPA era — koios/kairos/mnemosyne/roles ('a Mathematical Phonetic Alphabet of normalized invariants makes universal cross-domain structure detectable'); (3) Apr-May 2026 substrate era — agora/stoa/zoo/exploratory ('a versioned-symbol, challenge-gated, multi-agent substrate with calibration-first playground tiers can coordinate honest discovery'); (4) May 2026 ops era — pipelines/scripts/tests ('self-describing manifests and daemonized scanners make the fleet legible'). The common load-bearing bet: falsification-first discipline plus diverse search substrates yields discoveries; the menagerie is where most variants of that bet were tried once and abandoned.
strategic_read: Three things stand out. First, the menagerie died honestly: the best artifacts here are kills (Geometry 1 falsified by its own SVD, char-2 and LLM-mutation hypotheses killed by pre-registered pilots, random-beats-guided admitted in the tournament summary, coherence collapse admitted in Rhea's own README the week of its triumph). The program's claimed crown jewel — 'the discipline that killed our own strongest claims' — was largely forged HERE, in tensor_decomp_qd, kairos/patterns, and exploratory/zoo, not in the live spine; if the June reframing (Prometheus as TDD-layer/progress-meter) is the way forward, this domain contains its best working examples and they should be promoted to templates, not left as fossils. Second, the single highest-leverage unconsumed asset in the entire long tail is the Lean/Mathlib proof harness: the reassessment itself says the only Goodhart-proof fitness is external truth, and a green-tested external-truth gate has been sitting unwired since 2026-05-29 — connecting it to whatever organism/harness gets built is cheap and directly serves both the v3 reframing and Harmonia's 'stall is representational/interface' diagnosis. Third, beware revival-by-mislabel: the reassessment's §19 revival cluster (Rhea+Ignis+Kairos) rests on a wrong description of kairos and on Rhea results whose headline number (92% SR) is confounded by coherence collapse and was never replicated; any revival should start with a cheap re-evaluation of the March checkpoints under a coherence-honest metric, not with new evolution runs. The March-era vision projects (aethon, arcanum) are untested rather than falsified — they are the program's only genuinely novelty-seeking (vs gate-passing) objectives, which is exactly the objective-monoculture gap lens 6 identifies — but their code is respectively absent and unexercised, so they are options, not assets. Everything MPA-era can stay archived: its thesis was properly killed.
